subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should this stay in live-repro/manual-review until the active Ollama `api`, `baseUrl`, and raw OpenClaw request/response are captured, or should maintainers route it as an immediate repair?
rationale: Current source and the reported release already consume native `tool_calls`, while the issue body says the routing chain uses `/v1`, so automation cannot safely choose between a source bug and an unsupported configuration without proof.

options.title: Require live capture first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for the resolved provider config plus redacted OpenClaw/Ollama request-response logs before assigning a repair.

options.title: Queue repair after native proof
options.body: If the capture shows `api: "ollama"` and native `/api/chat` returned `tool_calls` that OpenClaw dropped, route a targeted provider/runtime fix.

options.title: Close if `/v1` is confirmed
options.body: If the active config is legacy OpenAI-compatible `/v1`, close or resolve as documented unsupported tool-calling mode and point to native Ollama configuration.

recommendation.title: Require live capture first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for the resolved provider config plus redacted OpenClaw/Ollama request-response logs before assigning a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on Ollama plain-text tool-call promotion makes this the best available routing owner for the proof-sufficiency choice.
